molecule_name: Allogeneic iPSC-derived CD58KO Anti-MICA/MICB CAR-ADR-expressing T-cells FT836

mechanism_of_action.plain_language: FT836 is an allogeneic, induced pluripotent stem cell (iPSC)-derived T-cell therapy engineered to express a chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) targeting MICA/MICB proteins on tumor cells. It also includes a knockout of CD58 to enhance persistence and an ADR to improve safety.
mechanism_of_action.molecular_action: CAR-T cells targeting MICA/MICB proteins on tumor cells, with CD58 knockout and ADR expression.

clinical_settings: Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinoma

data_notes.record_scope: FT836 is an investigational cell therapy product currently in preclinical or early clinical development. Information is limited to preclinical data and early clinical trial registrations.
